newsitem.title: USA: Trade executives from Americas meet in Miami.
newsitem.headline: Trade executives from Americas meet in Miami.

text.p: About 1,000 customs, trade, transportation and finance executives from North and South America will meet in Miami from Sunday at the Customs/ Trade/Finance Symposium of the Americas.
George Weise, Commissioner of U.S. Customs, will be one of the speakers.
Sessions will cover aviation, customs procedures, trade finance and trade automation.

On Sunday March 2, the conference will feature a cargo security work center and a session on customs private sector relations. A small and minority business session and a report on the state of the summit will also be held Sunday.
This is the third such symposium to grow out of President Clinton's Summit of the Americas that took place in Miami in 1994.
